issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Lecture attributes: in the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, lines 4-5) the fields 'lectureName' and 'numberOfInscribedStudents' are declared public, whereas the UML in the problem statement (problem_statement.md, lines 63-69) and the reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, lines 6-10) declare these attributes as private. This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended encapsulation (whether to access fields directly or implement getters/setters). Note: the template intentionally omits the other attributes (they are left as TODOs for students) — this issue is only about the access modifiers of the already-present fields.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template so the existing fields use the same visibility as the UML/solution: change 'public String lectureName;' and 'public int numberOfInscribedStudents;' to private. Keep the remaining attributes as TODOs for students to add (declare them private in the solution and in the UML). Optionally add a short comment in the template clarifying that fields are intentionally private and that students should add the missing private attributes and corresponding getters/setters to match the UML.
